_meta.datasheet_section: Pin Configuration (DHC package, top view) p2 + Pin Functions p7-8 + Order Information p2; package DHC16 LTC DWG 05-08-1706 Rev 0
_meta.package: DHC 16-lead DFN 5x3x0.75 mm, 0.5 mm pitch, EP = pin 17
_meta.notes: Grounds are typed power in our factory by design (FLEX_GND convention). [height] 0.8 mm max: DS DHC16 package drawing (05-08-1706): 0.75 ±0.05. [temp] DS Absolute Maximum Ratings: operating junction LTC3124E −40…125 °C (Notes 3,4); Order Information

pins.name: SWB
pins.note: Phase B switch node; inductor to VIN

pins.name: PGNDB
pins.note: [connect] DS p7 Pin Functions: PGNDB power ground

pins.name: SWA
pins.note: Phase A switch node; inductor to VIN

pins.name: PGNDA
pins.note: [connect] DS p7 Pin Functions: PGNDA power ground

pins.name: VIN
pins.note: 1.8 V max start-up (VOUT=0); >=10 uF ceramic to PGND; [connect] DS p7 Pin Functions: VIN input supply

pins.name: PWM/SYNC
pins.note: Do not leave floating. High=PWM, Low=Burst, clock=sync (then RT resistor required); [connect] DS p8 Pin Functions: PWM/SYNC do not leave floating; [enrich] DS Elec. Char.: PWM/SYNC VIH 0.9*VCC, VIL 0.1*VCC (thresholds relative to VCC, p.12); abs max 'all other pins' -0.3..6 V

pins.name: RT
pins.note: Resistor to SGND; fOSC ~ 56/RT(kOhm) MHz; [enrich] DS abs max: RT -0.3 V to VCC

pins.name: VC
pins.note: Error-amp output; compensation network to SGND; [enrich] DS abs max: VC -0.3 V to VCC

pins.name: FB
pins.note: VOUT = 1.2 V*(1+R1/R2); divider bottom to SGND; [enrich] DS abs max 'all other pins' -0.3..6 V

pins.name: SD
pins.note: Do not leave floating. >1.6 V on, <0.25 V off (output disconnected); [connect] DS p8 Pin Functions: SD do not leave floating; [enrich] DS Elec. Char.: SD input high 1.6 V min, low 0.25 V max; abs max 'all other pins' -0.3..6 V

pins.name: SGND
pins.note: [connect] DS p8 Pin Functions: SGND signal ground

pins.name: VOUTA
pins.note: Must be tied to VOUTB; >=10 uF per phase; [connect] DS p8 Pin Functions: VOUTA and VOUTB must be tied together

pins.name: NC
pins.note: Not connected internally; DS: connect to VOUTA/VOUTB for copper; [connect] DS p8 Pin Functions: NC, connect to VOUTA/VOUTB for wider VOUT copper

pins.name: VOUTB
pins.note: Must be tied to VOUTA; [connect] DS p8 Pin Functions: VOUTA and VOUTB must be tied together

pins.name: CAP
pins.note: ~100 nF low-ESR from CAP to VOUT

pins.name: PGND
pins.note: Exposed pad is PGND; must be soldered to the PCB ground plane; [connect] DS p7 Pin Functions: exposed pad is ground, must be soldered to PCB ground plane
